headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.listedInverseLabelTest_code
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U : ℕ) (X : OAI.ContingencyTables.Table r c)
  (s t :
    OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallContextCoordinates.Cells (OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.firstPaperSmall r c U)),
  Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.listedInverseLabelTest (List.ofFn r) (List.ofFn c) U
      (OAI.ContingencyTables.DensePrograms.matrixCode ↑X) (↑(↑s).1, ↑(↑s).2) (↑(↑t).1, ↑(↑t).2) =
    decide (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.InverseSupportTest r c U X (s, t))

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.listedInverseCount_eq_supportCount
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U : ℕ) (X : OAI.ContingencyTables.Table r c),
  Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.listedInverseCount (List.ofFn r) (List.ofFn c) U
      (OAI.ContingencyTables.DensePrograms.matrixCode ↑X) =
    Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.inverseSupportCount r c U X

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.listedInverseCount_eq_terminalInverseCount
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U L : ℕ),
  1 ≤ L →
    ∀ (X : OAI.ContingencyTables.Table r c),
      Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.listedInverseCount (List.ofFn r) (List.ofFn c) U
          (OAI.ContingencyTables.DensePrograms.matrixCode ↑X) =
        Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.terminalInverseCount r c U L X
